prompt.en: Freedom of the press is part of which fundamental freedom?
prompt.fr: La liberté de la presse fait partie de quelle liberté fondamentale?

options.en: Freedom of thought, belief, opinion and expression.
options.fr: La liberté de pensée, de croyance, d'opinion et d'expression.
La liberté de conscience et de religion.

explanation.en: Freedom of thought, belief, opinion and expression covers both freedom of speech and freedom of the press. The press is not a separate freedom belonging only to journalists.
explanation.fr: La liberté de pensée, de croyance, d'opinion et d'expression comprend à la fois la liberté de parole et la liberté de la presse. La presse ne constitue pas une liberté distincte réservée aux journalistes.

source.quote: Freedom of thought, belief, opinion and expression, including freedom of speech and of the press;

verification.evidence: Freedom of thought, belief, opinion and expression, including freedom of speech and of the press
